messages:
nora-people-ops: Heads up  an employee is planning an early retirement and wants an immediate in-service rollover of vested 401k funds and to confirm whether the final employer match will post during the vendor migration next week. Any special steps? @rachel-benefits @evan-payroll

ev an-payroll: Quick note: in-service rollovers are allowed only if the plan permits. If approved, we need a signed rollover request and to include the distribution code in the payroll file. If migration happens before we submit, distribution will be queued and processed post-cutover.

rachel-benefits: Plan allows in-service distributions for retirement >55 under Rule 72(t) exceptions, but paperwork required. For final employer match, we calculate match based on payroll file. If the final pay is processed before cutover and contains the match line, vendor should apply it. If not, we'll need a manual post-migration adjustment.

nora-people-ops: So action items: get signed rollover form, ensure payroll includes distribution code, and if pay is during blackout flag it as PRIORITY_ROLL. Is that correct?

ev an-payroll: Yes. Ticket template we need: Employee name and ID, distribution type (in-service rollover), target custodian, check EFT info, payroll period, and attach signed form. Use deduction code: RD401K_DIST. If during blackout, mark PRIORITY_ROLL and include contact phone.

sam-finance: Finance note: distributions and any manual match adjustments affect cashflow and tax reporting. Please include estimated amounts and expected processing date in the ticket so finance can plan. Also note potential 1099-R/W-2 impacts for the tax year.

rachel-benefits: Also remind employee about tax consequences and potential penalties for early withdrawal if under 59.5 and not meeting an exception. For in-service rollovers to an IRA, prefer trustee-to-trustee transfer to avoid withholding. Include rollover preference on the form.

benefits-bot: Reminder: vendor migration blackout: 2026-10-01 00:00 PT -> 2026-10-02 23:59 PT. Emergency distribution tickets only during blackout. See migration checklist: https://benefits.example.com/migration-checklist

nora-people-ops: I'll email the employee the required form and a short note about timing: we may need to process the distribution after migration if final pay lands inside blackout. Will also add the PRIORITY_ROLL flag to the ticket if needed. Anything else? :thumbsup:
